name: RG20267
tagline: Traditional cast iron resilience with a wide-view flame display
description: The Northern Flame Balder is a heavy-duty, closed-combustion fireplace that combines a wide architectural presence with the timeless performance of premium cast iron. Crafted from high-quality Australian mineral iron ore, it features a broad firebox and an expansive ceramic glass door, offering an exceptional view of the fire. Designed for both efficiency and durability, its classic ribbed body maximizes surface area for heat radiation, while precision air controls and a dedicated ash drawer ensure an easy-to-manage, clean-burning experience.
features: Durable cast iron construction for high-capacity heat retention
Wide-format ceramic glass door for panoramic flame views
Primary and secondary air sliders for precision combustion control
Integrated air-wash system to maintain glass clarity
Easy-access removable ash pan with a dedicated secondary door
